title: Comparing the Pay Vendor Process in Dynamics GP with Dynamics 365 Business Central (2024)

chapters.title: Creating Payment Journals in Business Central
Managing Cash Flow with Payment Amounts
Using Vendor Priority to Optimize Payment Runs

features.name: Payment Journals
features.description: Business Central allows you to easily create payment journals and suggest vendors to pay based on criteria you've defined, similar to GP payment batches.

features.name: Suggest Vendor Payments
features.description: Functionality to automatically suggest vendor payments based on defined criteria such as due date and available discounts, allowing users to select previously saved defaults.

features.name: Vendor Priority
features.description: Functionality that allows users to set priority levels on vendors, ensuring payment runs prioritize high-priority vendors first when cash flow is constrained. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.
caveats: Vendor priority requires configuration on individual vendor cards

features.name: Payment Discount Application
features.description: Business Central can automatically include available payment discounts when suggesting vendor payments based on configured criteria.

features.name: Summarize Per Vendor Option
features.description: Option to consolidate multiple invoices into a single payment per vendor instead of creating one payment per invoice.
